question:
The given bar graph shows the foreign direct investment (in million dollars) in Country A from all over the world over the years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62f0590a7d0421fc64baa0cf0f3e6ce29a0587ef714e97e49608e7c7174b3424.png] 

What was the ratio of investment in 2018 to that in 2015?
solution:
**Given:**

Bar graph shows the foreign direct investment (in million dollars) in Country A from all over the world over the years.

**Formula used:**

Ratio of investment in 2018 to that in 2015 = (Investment in 2018) / (Investment in 2015)

**Calculation:**

By the given bar graph,

Investment in 2018 = 65 million dollars

Investment in 2015 = 60 million dollars

Ratio of investment in 2018 to that in 2015 = (65)/(60)

Simplify the ration,

⇒(65)/(60) = (13)/(12) = 13 : 12

**The ratio of investment in 2018 to that in 2015 was 13 : 12.**
